How to obtain a fixed date: Organizing online
applications and priority repayment order
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-11
What a fixed date does
Article 3-2 of the Housing Lease Protection Act
provides that when a leased home with a fixed
date enters an auction or public sale, the…
Where to obtain it
You can obtain a fixed date at the eup or myeon
office, dong community service center, or a
branch office of the city, county, or district…
How to obtain it online through the
Internet Registry Office
Online fixed-date applications have been
available through the Internet Registry Office
(www.iros.go.kr) since September 14, 2015.
Criteria for determining the order
A fixed date is an official record that places a
date on the contract.
